integrity.computation: Exact rational exhaustive matching enumeration through seven chords; exact symbolic integrals; executable standalone checker.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact iid chord representation, direct projection integrals, canonical Hoeffding decomposition, multivariate iid central limit theorem.
integrity.unproved_scope: No finite joint independence, no general set partitions, no quantified Gaussian convergence rate.

scientific_limitations: Only uniform perfect matchings; not general partitions, graph models or weighted matchings.
Finite crossing–nesting covariance is negative and finite independence does not hold.
The full finite bivariate generating law was previously known (Kasraoui–Zeng 2006); finite moment identities are derived evaluations, not claimed as new full distributions.
No classification of higher-order joint cumulants, convergence rate, or nonuniform variants is asserted.
Definitive historical priority of the explicit independent Gaussian pair limit is not established.
title: Exact crossing–nesting covariance and independent Gaussian fluctuations in uniform random matchings
